about_the_game:
Meet Pal, Your Personal AI Companion!

Ever wish you had a personal assistant who instantly knew everything about your study notes, work projects, or favorite hobbies? Now you can! "My AI Pal" is a charming desktop mascot powered by a private, local AI that you teach yourself.

By reading your documents, Pal becomes a knowledgeable partner, ready to answer your questions and help you find the information you need, right when you need it.

Teach Your Pal Anything

Building Pal’s knowledge is as easy as dragging and dropping a file. Have a PDF of study notes, a text file with your work research, or a guide to your favorite game? Just drop it onto Pal! It will instantly read and learn the content, transforming into a specialist on that topic. No programming or complex setup required.

Private and Secure Local AI

Your privacy is our priority. All of your documents and conversations are processed locally on your computer. Nothing is ever sent to the cloud, and no internet connection is required for the core AI functions. You can feel safe letting Pal learn about your personal projects, private notes, or confidential work materials. Your data is yours, and yours alone.

Let's customize our character!

Let's create a more personalized PAL by setting your own original character image!

A Friendly Desktop Companion

Pal lives on your desktop as a charming, unobtrusive companion. It's more than just a chat window; it's a friendly face ready to help. This widget-style app stays out of your way, making it easy to call upon Pal whenever a question comes to mind.

How You Can Use Pal

  • For Studying: Let Pal memorize your textbooks and notes, then quiz you before an exam.

  • For Work: Quickly find key information from long reports, meeting minutes, or technical documents.

  • For Hobbies: Create an expert on your favorite hobby, whether it's gardening, cooking, or gaming lore.

  • For Creative Projects: Keep your world-building bible or character notes organized and easily searchable by asking Pal.

Welcome Pal to your desktop and start building your one-of-a-kind AI assistant today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or GPU capable of running modern applications
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A dedicated graphics card (GPU) with at least 6 GB of VRAM is highly recommended for faster training and for creating larger, more complex AI models. Performance heavily depends on the AI model's parameters (such as MODEL, LAYER, BATCH_SIZE) that you can configure in the application. Increasing these parameters will significantly raise memory (RAM/VRAM) usage and may lead to system instability or crashes. It is strongly recommended to monitor your system's resource usage via the Task Manager when experimenting with larger parameter values.
